description:
Leidos has a new and exciting opportunity for a Mid-Level Defensive Cyber Software Developer in our INTEL Sector's Cyber & Analytics Business Area (CABA) .  Our talented team is at the forefront in Security Engineering, Computer Network Operations (CNO), Mission Software, Analytical Methods and Modeling, Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), and Cryptographic Key Management. At Leidos , we offer competitive benefits , including Paid Time Off, 11 paid Holidays, 401K with a 6% company match and immediate vesting, Flexible Schedules, Discounted Stock Purchase Plans, Technical Upskilling, Education and Training Support, Parental Paid Leave, and much more.  Join us and make a difference in National Security!  

 The Mid-Level Defensive Cyber Software Developer   will work with a diverse, highly skilled team to develop unique solutions for Cyber, EW, and PNT threats against US weapon systems.   Our products are responsible for alerting our varied array of customers of potential cyber and EW attacks by creative Adversaries highly skilled at attacking.   With that problem set in mind, our products need to be developed by equally creative minds that enjoy digging, researching, programming, questioning, and generally learning all they can do to do those exact things the Adversaries would.
  
 This is a full-time position with the Leidos Cyber Electromagnetic Activity (CEMA) team that is based in Lawton, OK, and will require the candidate to be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Clearance.
   
  Primary Responsibilities: 
 Developing software and/or techniques in the protection of data and network capabilities, as well as detection of, identification of and response to attacks, including working toward the most effective methods to present those findings to the user.
 Research and development of signature and behavior-based defensive techniques against adversarial attacks on tactical networks.
 Developing technical solutions that require collaboration with internal experts, deep analyses and understanding of impact on end-product/solution.
 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, computer engineering, cyber engineering, or similar degree from an ABET-accredited program
 Minimum 4+ years of professional development in C, C++, Rust, Go, or similar compiled languages
 Minimum 2+ years of professional experience with Python and Bash or a similar scripting language.
 Comfortable with software build systems, such as CMake, Meson, or Bazel
 Experience with version control tools
 Experience with UI/UX development
 Familiarity with an iterative software design process, such as Agile and/or Continuous Delivery, as well as common tooling associated with the process, such as Jira and Jenkins
 A good understanding of networking – protocols at all layers of the networking stack and network architecture.
 Knowledge of general software development best practices
 Professional experience in Linux, up to and included basic administration
 Must be a US CITIZEN and able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI Clearance
 Ability to travel to customer sites up to 20% of time
   
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience using Wireshark
 Firm Grasp of Cybersecurity as well as recent tracking of cyber events
 Certifications such as Network+, Security+, CySA+, Linux+
   
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
October 6, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $87,100.00 - $157,450.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
